'''Alex Shulman''' (also published as '''Alex Schulman''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Boxborough tournament]] on 16 June 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS w/ Kessel Runs]], according to Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2537">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-27-if-mike-dalton-can-do-it-so-can-id2537/ if-mike-dalton-can-do-it-so-can-i], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 27 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-27-if-mike-dalton-can-do-it-so-can-id2537/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
